50–52（多数国家受限或需协调）: 50–52 (restricted or subject to coordination in most countries)
ITU《无线电规则》把全球划分为三个区域，各国的频率划分与业余波段规划随之不同，: The ITU Radio Regulations divide the world into three regions; national allocations and amateur band plans differ accordingly, so operate according to the region you are in.
与频率数据库比对，判断是否合法设台、是否超标发射或占用无许可频段。: Compare against the frequency database to judge whether the station is licensed, over-power, or on an unauthorised band.
中国无线电协会业余无线电分会（CRAC）等，协助考试、题库与频率协调工作。: For example the Chinese Radio Amateurs Club (CRAC); assists with exams, question pools and frequency coordination.
中继台频率应预留足够的收发频差与亚音，避免与相邻中继产生互调。: Repeater frequencies should reserve enough transmit/receive split and tone separation to avoid intermodulation with neighbouring repeaters.
为中继台统筹分配收发频率对与亚音，是 VHF/UHF 频率协调中最常见的场景。: Assigning repeater transmit/receive frequency pairs and tones in an organised way; the most common scenario in VHF/UHF coordination.
主管部门用固定 / 移动监测站测定频率占用、带宽、场强与调制特征，是查处非法设台: Authorities use fixed and mobile monitoring stations to measure frequency occupancy, bandwidth, field strength and modulation characteristics — the technical means for dealing with illegal stations and harmful interference.
先区分是自身设备或天线问题，还是外来干扰；自查方法见「射频干扰排查」页。: First distinguish your own equipment or antenna problems from external interference; self-check methods are on the "RF interference troubleshooting" page.
全球频谱管理的根本文件，含频率划分表与编号脚注（如 5.282 卫星业余业务）；: The foundational document of global spectrum management, containing the table of frequency allocations and numbered footnotes (e.g. 5.282 for the amateur-satellite service); countries build their national allocations on it.
出现同频或邻频干扰时，通过协商调整频率、亚音、功率或天线方向来化解，而非单方面加: When co-channel or adjacent-channel interference occurs, resolve it by agreeing to adjust frequency, tone, power or antenna direction — not by unilaterally increasing power.
划分（把频段列入频率划分表）→ 分配（规定给一个或多个部门在指定区域使用）→ 指: Allocation (entering the band in the table of frequency allocations) → allotment (assigning it to one or more services in a given area) → assignment (licensing it to a specific station): the generic spectrum-management flow.
判断干扰是否危及无线电导航、遇险通信等安全业务，以及是否超出 ITU 规定的保护: Judging whether interference endangers safety services such as radionavigation or distress traffic, and whether it exceeds the protection ratios set by the ITU; this decides the handling priority.
制定《无线电规则》，划分三大区域并分配全球频谱，是各层规则的源头。: Issues the Radio Regulations, divides the world into three regions and allocates global spectrum; the source of the rules at every level.
协调无效或属非法占用时，向无线电管理部门投诉举报，并附上完整证据。: If coordination fails or the use is illegal, complain to the radio regulatory authority with complete evidence.
协调本地区 VHF/UHF 中继频率、亚音与覆盖，受理邻频与互调干扰投诉。: Coordinate local VHF/UHF repeater frequencies, tones and coverage, and handle adjacent-channel and intermodulation interference complaints.
受干扰时先自查设备与天线，再走协调流程；完整的时间与录音证据是申诉的关键。: When interfered with, check your own equipment and antenna first, then follow the coordination process; complete time-stamped and recorded evidence is the key to a complaint.
受理投诉或由监测发现异常，登记频率、时间、地点与干扰样式。: Accept the complaint or detect an anomaly through monitoring, then log frequency, time, location and interference pattern.
各国政府无线电管理机构（我国为工业和信息化部及其无线电管理机构），负责频率划分、: Each country's government radio regulatory body (in China, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and its radio regulatory agencies), responsible for allocation, licensing and enforcement.
向受影响方或当地中继协调组织反映，协商调整频率、亚音或功率。: Report it to the affected party or the local repeater coordination body and negotiate adjusting frequency, tone or power.
向当地频率协调组织或主管部门说明用途、拟用频率、功率、台址与预计覆盖范围。: Tell the local frequency coordination body or administration the purpose, intended frequency, power, site and expected coverage.
在 ITU 框架内制定各区业余波段规划，代表爱好者协调国际事务。: Draws up regional amateur band plans within the ITU framework and represents amateurs in international matters.
在多个用户共用同一频段（尤其是 VHF/UHF 中继与信标）时，协商分配频率、亚: The process of negotiating the allocation of frequencies, tones and coverage among multiple users sharing a band (especially VHF/UHF repeaters and beacons) to avoid mutual interference.
官方或 IARU 对每一波段内各模式 / 带宽可用频段的规定；我国属 IARU: Official or IARU rules on which sub-bands and bandwidths each mode may use within a band; China is in IARU Region 3.
对合法台站责令整改或协调避让，对非法台站依法查处；危及安全业务时优先处置。: Order licensed stations to correct the problem or coordinate avoidance; deal with illegal stations according to law; safety services take priority.
按指定频率与亚音试运行，记录实际覆盖与干扰情况；必要时调整频率、功率或天线。: Operate on the assigned frequency and tone, recording actual coverage and interference; adjust frequency, power or antenna if needed.
本页为通识整理，不构成法律意见；具体流程请咨询当地无线电管理机构或业余组织。: This page is a general summary and does not constitute legal advice; consult your local radio regulatory authority or amateur organisation for specific procedures.
检查本台发射是否超标、是否产生谐波与互调，排除「自己干扰自己」的可能。: Check whether your transmissions exceed limits or generate harmonics and intermodulation, ruling out "interfering with yourself".
比对该频段已有的中继、信标与相邻频道，评估同频、邻频与互调干扰风险。: Compare with existing repeaters, beacons and adjacent channels in the band and assess co-channel, adjacent-channel and intermodulation risks.
波段规划会随国际与国内规定更新，操作前以主管部门与 IARU 最新版本为准。: Band plans change with international and national rules; before operating, use the latest versions from the administration and the IARU.
用监测站测定频率、带宽与调制特征，必要时交叉测向定位发射源。: Use monitoring stations to determine frequency, bandwidth and modulation characteristics, and cross direction-finding to locate the source if needed.
记录起止时间（UTC）、频率、干扰样式、来向与音调特征，尽量录音留证。: Log start and end times (UTC), frequency, interference pattern, direction and tone characteristics, and record audio if possible.
跨区操作时以所持执照与当地规定为准，不要照搬其他区域的波段规划。: When operating across regions, follow your licence and local rules; do not copy another region's band plan.
通过后登记备案并向协调组织公示，便于其他台站避让，避免重复占用。: Once approved, register it and publish it with the coordination body so other stations can avoid it and duplicate use is prevented.
